lesson.name: Learn the Sicilian with 2...e6
lesson.description: Watch a video to learn the ins and outs of the flexible 2...e6 Sicilian for both Black and White.

{White threatens a fork on c7. How should Black defend?} 8... axb5 {[%wrong
There's a better move. Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Capture a knight.]}
(8... Bd6 $2 9. Nxd6+ {White is winning. Try to find a stronger bishop move.})
9. Nxb5 {Good start! White threatens the deadly Nc7+. What strong forcing move
gives Black an OK game?} Bb4+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a
good check.] [%hint Develop with check.]} (9... Ra5 $2 10. Nc7+ {White is
better. Try to find a stronger and more forcing move.}) 10. c3 {Good choice!
How should you fight for control of the a5-d8 diagonal?} Ba5 {[%wrong White is
better. Try to find a way to control the a5-d8 diagonal.] [%hint Attack
White's b6 bishop with your bishop.]} 11. Nc7+ {Good move! How can Black reach
an OK position?} Qxc7 {[%wrong Illegal.] [%hint Sacrifice material to get out
of check.]} (11... Ke7 $2 12. Bc5+ {White is better. Try to find a strong
sacrifice to escape the check.}) (11... Kf8 $2 12. Nxa8 {White is better. Try
to find a strong sacrifice to escape the check.}) (11... Kd8 $2 12. Nxa8+ {
White is better. Try to find a strong sacrifice to escape the check.}) 12. Bxc7
{Nice move! What's next?} Bxc7 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a
good capture.] [%hint Capture a piece.] Well played! Black's three pieces
balance out the White queen and there's an exciting game ahead.} *

{White's setup with f3 isn't dangerous in the Kan Variation. How should
Black reach a good position?} 8... d5 {[%wrong There's a stronger option. Try
to find a way to fight back in the center.] [%hint Offer a pawn trade in the
center.]} (8... d6 $2 9. g4 {White is doing well. Try to find a stronger move
with the same pawn.}) (8... O-O $2 9. g4 {White is doing well. Try to find a
strong pawn move.}) (8... Bxc3 $2 9. Qxc3 {White is doing well. Try to find a
strong pawn move.}) (8... e5 $2 9. Nf5 {White is better. Try to find a
stronger pawn move.}) 9. Bd3 {Good start! How can Black use the strong pawn
center to win material?} e5 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find a
strong threat.] [%hint Advance a pawn with a threat.]} (9... dxe4 $2 10. Bxe4 {
White is OK. Try to find a good threat.}) (9... Bxc3 $2 10. Qxc3 {White is OK.
Try to find a strong threat instead.}) 10. Nde2 {Good choice! How can Black
win material?} d4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Find a good way to advance a
pawn with a fork.] [%hint Advance a pawn with a fork.] Good choice! Black will
win a piece and should win the game!} (10... dxe4 $2 11. fxe4 {White is OK.
Try to find a stronger move.}) *

{How should Black defend g7?} 8... O-O {[%wrong There's a better move to
defend g7. Try to find one that also secures your king.] [%hint Castle to
defend g7 and safeguard your king.]} (8... Ng6 $5 {This is playable, but
there's a better way to defend g7. Try to find it.}) (8... Kf8 $2 9. Qe2 {
There's a better way for your king to defend g7. Try to find it.}) (8... g6 $2
9. Bg5 {White can take advantage of Black's weak dark squares. Try to find a
better way to defend g7.}) (8... Rg8 $2 9. c4 {Black will have a hard time
finding a safe square for the king. Try to find a stronger move.}) 9. Bh6 {
Good move! How should you prevent checkmate?} Ng6 {[%wrong White will mate
next turn. Try again.] [%hint Block White's queen from reaching g7.] Well
played! Black has a good position.} (9... g6 $2 10. Bxf8 {White wins material.
Try to find a better move to prevent mate.}) (9... Bd4 $2 10. Nxd4 {White wins
material. Try to find a better move to prevent mate.}) (9... Nf5 $2 10. exf5 {
White wins material. Try to find a better move to prevent mate.}) (9... Bxf2+
$2 10. Rxf2 {White wins material. Try to find a better move to prevent mate.})

{White's c4 setup isn't too dangerous for Black if you can get your f8 bishop
to its best square. What should Black play?} 6... Bb4 {[%wrong There's a
better developing move. Try to find it.] [%hint Develop and make a pin.] Well
played! Black has a strong threat to win the e4 pawn and reaches a good
position.} (6... Bc5 $5 {This is possible, but there's a better square for the
bishop. Try to find it.}) (6... Be7 $5 {This is possible, but there's a better
and more active square for the bishop. Try to find it.}) (6... Bd6 $2 7. Ndb5 {
White wins time attacking the bishop. Try to find a stronger move.}) (6... Qa5
$2 7. Nb3 {The queen must retreat again. Try to find a stronger move.}) *
